title: Islands and Issue 1: tonight's pictures
summary: Your 'Both: islands, then Issue 1'. Dole and Pym passed earlier tonight. After the 3:51 reset: Pinhold's symbol fix, Ashmarket, Gaptooth, the tower room and the High Table, the cover (one automatic redo) and panel p1-3. From 04:03 every ChatGPT run hung (six 20-minute timeouts across p1-2, the p1-3 fix and p2-3), so the run stopped there; p2-5 and the four customs-men panels were not started.
